name: Azure Artifacts Credential Provider
description: Installs the Azure Artifacts Credential Provider so dotnet/nuget can authenticate to Azure Artifacts feeds

version.description: Select the Azure Artifacts Credential Provider version to install. Use a release tag (e.g. '2.0.4').

installLibsecretAndXdgUtils.description: Install libsecret-1-0 and xdg-utils (Debian/Ubuntu) for interactive browser-based authentication. Disable to skip if already present.
